display.purpose: Primary landing and dashboard hero titles.

headline.purpose: Section headers and major screen titles.

label.purpose: Metadata, status pills, and form labels.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Default card lift and hover response.

shadows.name: ambient-medium
shadows.purpose: Active panels and focused content blocks.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for review, add, and login flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b06a4a; color: #f3eadf; padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; font: 600 1rem/1.2 Inter, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.24), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c07a4a; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d9c4a6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions that should stay quiet.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #f3eadf; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #463d36; border-radius: 14px; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.2 Inter, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #2c2521; border-color: #5e6a43; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d9c4a6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text entry for words, meanings, and practice answers.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #251f1b; color: #f3eadf; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #463d36; border-radius: 14px; font: 400 1rem/1.6 Inter, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #c8b59f; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #b06a4a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(176,106,74,0.18); }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: Primary content container for dashboard tiles and practice panels.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #2c2521; color: #f3eadf; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #463d36; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.24), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Desktop navigation with icon plus label and restrained state change.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #2c2521; color: #f3eadf; padding: 16px; border-right: 1px solid #463d36; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 14px; color: #c8b59f; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #3a332e; color: #f3eadf; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: #3d2f26; color: #f3eadf; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Small state marker for correctness and review status.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(176,106,74,0.16); color: #f3eadf; border: 1px solid rgba(217,196,166,0.2); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.2 Inter, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like a quiet workspace at dusk, warm, contained, and focused on the learner’s next useful action. It is intentionally minimal and low-noise so the vocabulary list, review loop, and AI help stay readable and calm.

The visual language avoids spectacle. Surfaces are warm and grounded, hierarchy is strong, and the AI layer stays supportive rather than dominant. The system rejects generic SaaS chrome, noisy neon AI styling, school-like worksheets, and toy flashcard visuals.
keyCharacteristics: Warm and grounded, not bright or clinical.
Clear hierarchy for review, practice, and correction.
Calm AI assistance, never visually dominant.

rules.name: The Warm-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use warm neutrals for almost everything, and reserve accent colors for real actions, status, or progress.

rules.name: The Scan-First Rule
rules.body: Headlines should be brief and informative, body copy should be short enough to skim, and labels should clarify state without repeating the obvious.

rules.name: The Surface-First Rule
rules.body: A surface should read correctly even without shadow. Shadows refine depth, they do not define it.

dos: Do keep most surfaces in warm dark neutrals, using cream text for readability.
Do use umber, rust, and moss only where they clarify action or progress.
Do preserve a compact, focused layout with clear hierarchy and low visual noise.
Do make review, add-word, and practice actions easy to find without scanning the whole page.
donts: Don't make the UI look like a generic SaaS dashboard with empty hero stats.
Don't lean into noisy neon AI branding.
Don't use school-like worksheets that feel punitive.
Don't make it feel like a toy flashcard app, a corporate admin panel, or a consumer social feed.
Don't overwhelm the surface with bright gradients, high-saturation accents, or decorative chrome.
